items.prep: chopped (reserve a few leaves for garnish)

instructions: Combine the olive oil, cubed mozzarella, garlic, basil, crushed red pepper, and salt and pepper in a large bowl, stirring together.
Place the tomatoes in a saucepan; use your hands to crush them. Simmer over medium heat for about 15 minutes, until slightly thickened. Remove from the stove.
Add the tomatoes to the mozzarella mixture in the bowl. Allow to sit for at least 30 minutes, or up to one day refrigerated.
Boil the pasta as directed. Drain, then pour the hot pasta over the sauce. Mix and serve. Makes about four servings.
notes: Dairy recipe (mozzarella). From a newspaper clipping; the clipping has a handwritten "crushed" annotation above the tomatoes — the recipe crushes the whole tomatoes by hand in step 2.

tips.text: The 30-minute rest lets the warm tomatoes soften the mozzarella slightly and the flavors meld — don't skip it.
tips.title: Let it sit

tips.text: Top with the reserved basil leaves before serving.
tips.title: Garnish
